units.source_text: “对了，没关系，现在是农闲，一早不会有行人的。

en.t: Yes, it is all right. This is the slack season on the farms, so no one will be passing by so early in the morning.

units.source_text: 不过，会不会有人上山呢？”

en.t: But I wonder if anyone might be going up the mountain.

units.source_text: 女子喃喃自语，拖着系了半截的腰带来回走动。

en.t: The woman murmured to herself and paced back and forth, dragging the sash she had only half tied.
